headline: Ice Climber's autopilot now gives up on a lost peak 5x sooner
lede: Session 150 (slot b) tuned the Ice Climber co-op solver's safety net from a flat 60,000-tick wall down to a budget that scales with the mountains still to climb, proven by a grown audit — while the studio's browser outage narrowed to something sharper.

notes.text: The autopilot's outer bail is now per-remaining-mountain (12k x peaks left, counted from when plan() starts). A stuck final mountain aborts in ~12k ticks instead of 60k; real solves peak at 4743 ticks so nothing legitimate changes, and PROGNOSIS resumes keep their full budget.

icecheck grew 42 to 47 gates: a BAIL section pins the scaled budget, the entry-relative resume, and the headroom. Mutants proven red-then-green — restoring the flat 60k trips 2 gates; switching to absolute accounting trips the scaling pin AND the aged-state resume gate.

This host can't run browser JavaScript at all: system Chrome and bundled Chrome-for-Testing SIGABRT, and even native WKWebView's JS bridge fails on `1+1`. So the mobile 390px pill nudges and watchcheck soak pilots (issue parts 1+3) move to a healthy node; pill positions were left untouched rather than blindly nudged.
